summary: Pre-request checks the public document cannot express (it types the inputs optional): `conduyt-auth delete-sessions` needs exactly one of --id <session> or --scope others; `users notifications update-user-preferences` needs --preferences, --sounds-team-chat, or both (unless --stdin). Each is a usage error (exit 2) before any request; bare delete-sessions prints help. Checks live in internal/cli/conditional_requirements.go plus one call per command. Under the global --dry-run a MISSING input is not an error (the preview prints, as for every generated required flag); a passed-but-wrong value still is (r2). An empty or blank --preferences is a usage error (the serializer would drop it and send {}) (r2 P3).
reason: The old prints had them as generator-emitted required-flag checks (the earlier spec marked id and preferences required); the 86cb86329 document made id optional beside the new scope and preferences optional beside the new sounds, so the fresh generator dropped them (Codex reprint637-r1 P2). Source: the generator, not a ledger entry.
